notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p]Hello Pilots—thank you for supporting [b]Blind Simulator[/b].[/p][p]This is a lightweight update focused on [b]gameplay logic stability[/b] and [b]rendering optimizations[/b].[/p][h3][b]Gameplay Logic Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Hardened edge-case handling for [b]mini-game score/time aggregation[/b], and made [b]platform-specific branches[/b] more robust.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Rendering Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Replaced textures/materials on certain objects that [b]didn’t respond to specific sonar events[/b], improving [b]visibility[/b] and [b]visual consistency[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Shop BGM[/b] could continue after [b]quest success/failure[/b] in the Store stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned [b]collision SFX[/b] triggers and levels for several store items.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep improving with your feedback. Thank you![/p][p]— [b]The Pathfinder Dev Team[/b][/p]

tags.bug: [*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Shop BGM[/b] could continue after [b]quest success/failure[/b] in the Store stage.[/p][/*]
[*][p]Tuned [b]collision SFX[/b] triggers and levels for several store items.[/p][/*]

notes.title: Update Note
notes.content: [h2]Update Notes[/h2][p]Hello, this is the ‘Blind Simulator’ development team.[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting and enjoying our game![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][h3][b]New Feature:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Pinata Mini-Game Leaderboard:[/b][/p][p]You can now view your own records separately from the global community records.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved rendering quality inside the apartment[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the slope at the house entrance for smoother navigation[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue working hard to bring you even better experiences in future updates.[/p][p]Thank you![/p][p]– The Pathfinder Team[/p]

tags.feature: Pinata Mini-Game Leaderboard: You can now view your own records separately from the global community records.

tags.bug: Improved rendering quality inside the apartment

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the slope at the house entrance for smoother navigation

notes.title: Update Note
notes.content:
[h1][b]Release Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hello, PathFinder players![/p][p]Thank you all for purchasing our game. We’re excited to share the highlights of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s New[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added new failure condition:[/b] If you attempt to smuggle any item out of a shop, the mission will now immediately fail.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where UI elements would sometimes render above the hand model in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved subtitle placement in the Achievements system for better visibility and usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique descriptive text for each failure scenario so you always know exactly what went wrong.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a problem where ceiling geometry in apartment corridors wouldn’t render correctly on buses and subways.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Braille map subtitles inside shops so that they’re affected by Sonar as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked sound effects and haptic feedback when colliding with certain items in shops for a more polished feel.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep the updates coming—thank you for your support!
—The PathFinder Development Team[/p]

tags.feature: [b]Added new failure condition:[/b] If you attempt to smuggle any item out of a shop, the mission will now immediately fail.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where UI elements would sometimes render above the hand model in the main menu.
Resolved a problem where ceiling geometry in apartment corridors wouldn’t render correctly on buses and subways.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the Braille map subtitles inside shops so that they’re affected by Sonar as intended.
